description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7 side quests): Aldmere's three ballistae on the ridge over the King's Road shoot at any giant on the road. Silence them (smash them, or tear them up and throw them at stage 6): 150 XP. It counts for the crown's sabotage road (quest.war_engines' second half) - and each engine broken is an offence against Aldmere. It starts once a stage-4 giant discovers the ridge.

stages.objective: Silence the three ballistae on Ballista Ridge
stages.waiting_text: Three ballistae and their crews hold the ridge east of the King's Road, behind a shield wall. Breaking them makes Aldmere your enemy.
